complete_examples.text: In this study, an analytical solution is developed for calculating the first four raw moments of response functions.

However, how to solve the first four raw moments of response functions accurately and effectively is an issue that needs to be resolved in order to develop the application advantages of the moment methods in probabilistic analysis.
